import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2
            +(p[3]+p[4]*T+p[5]*T**2)*eps*np.exp(-p[6]*eps)
            +p[7]*eps+p[8]*eps**2+p[9]*eps**2*T)
